com.stockroom - package com.stockroom
Root package of Stockroom, a Swing-based inventory management system that records stock items in a ledger, derives their stock status and persists them to CSV.
com.stockroom.exception - package com.stockroom.exception
Checked exception hierarchy used to report invalid input, missing items and duplicate names.
com.stockroom.model - package com.stockroom.model
Domain model of the inventory: stock items and their derived stock status.
com.stockroom.persistence - package com.stockroom.persistence
Persistence layer that saves and loads the inventory, backed by a CSV file.
com.stockroom.service - package com.stockroom.service
Business logic layer: input validation and the inventory manager that adds, updates, deletes and queries items.
com.stockroom.ui - package com.stockroom.ui
Swing user interface: the application entry point, the main window and the ledger table model.
com.stockroom.ui.components - package com.stockroom.ui.components
Custom-painted Swing components that make up the Stockroom Ledger look, such as stamp badges, ledger buttons, slip fields and toasts.
com.stockroom.ui.theme - package com.stockroom.ui.theme
The Stockroom Ledger design system: colour and font constants and bundled font loading.
